contract_deviations: A9 quotation totals: a separate BEFORE INSERT trigger on quotations (fn_quotation_insert_totals, SECURITY INVOKER, trigger-only) sums the quote's items into subtotal / gst_amount / total, instead of extending the items totals trigger; a new quote therefore always starts at 0 whatever is supplied, and the seed upsert still gets its real totals.

fn_quote_item_guard: a parent quote outside the caller's org or with a different org_id now raises not_found (42501), replacing the Sprint B bad_payload DETAIL 'org_id', so foreign and random quote ids are indistinguishable (SEC2-06).

fn_sample_create(p_buyer_id, p_product_id, p_inquiry_id, p_qty_grams, p_courier, p_tracking_no, p_lot_no, p_note, p_mark_sent) is a new SECURITY INVOKER RPC not listed in contracts section 4; it returns jsonb {id, code}.

SEC2-07: the item guard's wall applies to every web session (SET ROLE authenticated/anon/authenticator, the same test fn_current_org uses) whose role is not 'owner', NULL included; trusted scripts connected as postgres stay exempt instead of being exempt by a NULL role, because seeds and dev3's fixtures insert unpriced items as postgres.

0007 goes slightly beyond A10's wording: authenticated also loses EXECUTE on fn_is_active, fn_current_fy, fn_format_money and the pgcrypto functions (no web path calls them); PUBLIC's default EXECUTE is revoked globally for the migration role (Postgres cannot revoke PUBLIC's default per schema), and 0001's schema-level authenticated default on routines is removed at the end of each run (SEC1-11).
open_issues: Hosted readiness (security sign-off): 0007's audit scrub (DELETE / UPDATE on audit_log, FORCE RLS, no write policy) and the 0005/0006 definers need the migration / function owner to bypass RLS (postgres BYPASSRLS on Supabase); under a NOBYPASSRLS owner the scrub would silently touch 0 rows. Confirm with SELECT rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user on credentials day, then re-run ci:tenant-check against the hosted DATABASE_URL.

Hosted: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES changes only the current role's defaults; Supabase's supabase_admin defaults cannot be changed by us. Migrations create functions as postgres, so this is covered, and ci:tenant-check check 10 reads the connecting role's defaults.
